note: A map8 whose four items are two pairs with the *same* key value: sym8 "a" -> ubyte 1, then sym8 "a" -> ubyte 2. size 11 = the count octet plus the ten item octets, count 4. The clause makes such a map invalid, so the reader must refuse it; before the duplicate comparison existed this decoded and was admitted.

The same map from the writer's side. A writer whose domain exceeds what its reader accepts emits octets it then refuses to read back, which is why the reader's duplicate comparison owes the writer one as well.

properties with fields 1-3 null and field 4, subject (declared string, not mandatory), carried as a zero-length array of str8 elements: e0 02 00 a1 is array8 with size 2 (the count octet plus the constructor octet), count 0 and element constructor a1. The types section says a null value and a zero-length array with a correct element type both describe an absence of a value, so this field is not set exactly as a null would leave it not set, and the section is admitted with the field still carried as the empty array.
